Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10th - June 20th, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip flops/sandals
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting)
- Insect repellent
- Power adapter/charger
- Medications
- Cash and credit cards
- Lightweight backpack for day trips
